theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A))) → ∀ τ : Fin m → Eucl P, Orthonormal ℝ τ → ∀ f : Eucl (P + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∫ z in {z : Eucl (P + 1) | ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ z))) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (range τ)}, f z ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))) = ∫ σ : ℝ, ∫ w in (Submodule.span ℝ (range τ) : Set (Eucl P)), f ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons σ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ w))) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))
